title: mimosa daleoides var. paraguariensis
intro: Mimosa daleoides var. paraguariensis, commonly known as Paraguay tea, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family, used as a medicinal and cultural plant in South America. The health benefits of Paraguay tea include reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and potentially lowering blood pressure. It has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-ulcerative, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Paraguay tea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and uses.
